<document id="plan-basic">
The Basic plan
Basic is Tallowbrook's free plan. The monthly fee is $0.00, there's no minimum balance, and you get the same app, debit card and support as every other member.

## What's included

- **Monthly fee:** $0.00
- **ATMs:** free at BrookLink ATMs. Out-of-network withdrawals cost $2.50 each.
- **Foreign transaction fee:** 3% of the purchase amount
- **Card replacement:** $5.00
- **Expedited card shipping:** $25.00
- **Savings Pockets:** 0.50% APY
- **Cushion:** not available on Basic
- **Daily card spending limit:** $3,000
- **Daily ATM limit:** $500

## Good to know

International wires aren't available on Basic. You can still receive them. If you travel or send money abroad often, Plus or Premium will usually cost less over a year.

You can change plans any time in the app under Profile, then Plan. Upgrades start right away. Downgrades start on your next billing date.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
<document id="fee-changes-2026">
What changed in the March 2026 fee update
We updated our fees on March 1, 2026. Here's everything that changed and what stayed the same.

## What changed

- **Plus monthly fee:** from $4.00 to $5.00.
- **Plus foreign transaction fee:** from 1.5% to 1%.
- **Out-of-network ATM fee on Basic and Plus:** from $2.00 to $2.50 per withdrawal.
- **Plus free out-of-network withdrawals:** from 2 to 3 a month.

## What stayed the same

Basic is still free. Premium is still $15.00 a month with no ATM or foreign transaction fees. Card replacement, wire and cash deposit fees didn't change on any plan.

## Why we made these changes

Out-of-network ATM operators raised what they charge us, and we moved part of that cost into the fee. We lowered the Plus foreign transaction fee at the same time, so Plus members who travel pay less overall.

If the new Plus price doesn't work for you, you can move to Basic in the app. The change takes effect on your next billing date.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
<document id="wires-incoming">
Receiving a wire
You can receive domestic and international wires into your Tallowbrook account on any plan.

## What to give the sender

Your routing number, account number, full legal name and address are in the app under Account details, then Wire instructions. International senders also need our SWIFT code, shown on the same screen.

## Fees

| Plan | Incoming domestic wire | Incoming international wire |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | free | $10.00 |
| Plus | free | $10.00 |
| Premium | free | free |

## Timing

Domestic wires usually arrive within hours on a business day. International wires can take longer, depending on the sending bank.

## If a wire hasn't arrived

Ask the sender for the wire reference number and the date it was sent, then message support. Wires with a name that doesn't match your account name may be returned to the sender.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.
</document>
</documents>
